title: Confounders and controls
outcome: Explain confounders and controls using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Separate background from class. Training data show every healthy leaf on white paper and every spotted leaf on blue paper.
given: Goal is leaf condition, not paper colour. A proposed check uses both paper colours for each condition.

steps.label: Identify coupled variables
steps.detail: Condition and background change together in the original collection.

steps.label: Cross the conditions
steps.detail: Collect healthy-white, healthy-blue, spotted-white and spotted-blue cases.

steps.label: Inspect the shortcut
steps.detail: Compare predictions when the same leaf’s background changes under a controlled test.

explanation: A confounder can provide an alternative explanation for a result. Crossing conditions makes the intended feature and the nuisance feature less entangled.

counterfactual.change: New cases still use only healthy-white and spotted-blue.
counterfactual.prediction: The collection does not resolve the background confounding.
counterfactual.reason: The same two variables remain coupled instead of being varied separately.

student_task: Draw the four condition/background combinations. Which variables were coupled before, and why would collecting only healthy-white and spotted-blue again leave the confounding unresolved?
teacher_answer: Condition and background change together in the original collection. Collect healthy-white, healthy-blue, spotted-white and spotted-blue cases. Compare predictions when the same leaf’s background changes under a controlled test. Changed case: The collection does not resolve the background confounding. The same two variables remain coupled instead of being varied separately.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: A changed-background test can diagnose sensitivity; it does not prove the model’s complete internal reasoning.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
